title: GOV-0009: resolved Issues become no institutional learning
problem:
## Observed
> Every resolved Issue becomes potential institutional learning.
Nothing reads a resolved demand. Learnings from this repository's own WPs (the shell-eaten backtick, the wrong-tree verification, the empty-glob clone errors of WP-0018) live in session memory outside the repo; `docs/errata/` holds one case. A `RESOLVED` demand record has no field where a learning disposition is stated.

## Expected
A deterministic, offline form: a `RESOLVED` demand carries a learning disposition — a `docs/learnings/` entry or an explicit `NONE_DECLARED` — and the drift walker treats a `RESOLVED` demand with neither as drift. Explicit "nothing learned" is a claim; silence is not.

## Evidence
`grep -rn learning docs/ badf/demands/` → the doctrine sentence only, on `c510516`.

## Unknowns
Whether a "research agent" belongs here — it does not: it is capability, not a defect, and the skills-catalogue verdict placed such things in a research catalogue, not an implementation roadmap.

## Proposed work package
Patch tier, promised as a "separate Issue" in #19's scope boundary: schema field `learning` on demand records; `docs/learnings/` convention; drift test.
